footerDescription: Transfer files over your local network; share clipboard text across networks with optional Cloud Sync.
productScope: Local manual clipboard and file transfers are free. Automatic clipboard sync requires Pro; Shortcuts and cloud transfers have trial/Pro access. See the app for current offers. Files and photos require a reachable local network. Cloud Sync needs internet and supports clipboard text only. Automatic sync does not bypass iOS background or clipboard restrictions. Shortcuts require iOS 16+ and must be triggered. WinSend is an AirDrop-style alternative, not Apple AirDrop. WinSend does not deliberately compress transferred files; source apps or system export may change their representation, and device/network/storage limits still apply.
